resources.string: Fills the free space of a folder at a set time, with the app closed, then deletes the temporary files. At most one scheduled fill runs per day, and each keeps %1$s free for the system.
The schedule for the folder %1$s on %2$s stops. Its history stays.
Each run writes temporary files to the folder %1$s on %2$s until %3$s stays free, then deletes them. Your own files stay as they are.
At most one scheduled fill runs per day.
Filling needs a folder on built-in storage or a memory card that can be written now. Connect the storage or choose another folder.
Started %1$d min after the set time: the system delayed it, for example to save battery.
The folder is not on a connected storage device of this phone
The storage was not connected or not writable
Free space could not be measured
No free space above the part kept for the system
Writing stopped with an error; the temporary files were deleted
Temporary files remain. Connect the storage, open Filler and tap Delete remaining files
Skipped: a scheduled fill already ran today
Stopped before the end. Temporary files that could not be deleted are shown on the Filler screen
Writing temporary files to %1$s; they are deleted when it ends.
Opens the scheduled fills: the Filler fills a chosen folder at a set time, with the app closed, at most once a day, and lists every run with its result.

A schedule fills the free space of one folder at a set time, even with the app closed and after the phone restarts, then deletes the temporary files. It always keeps the usual amount free for the system, and at most one scheduled fill runs per day: a second one due the same day is skipped and the history says so.
Opens a new schedule with the folder the Filler screen uses by default.

Choose folder picks the folder, Time sets the hour and minute, Repeat sets how many days lie between two runs. Save asks for confirmation, naming the folder and the space kept free, and saves only a folder that can be written now. Cancel changes nothing.

Each saved schedule card with its folder, how often and at what time it runs, and its next run. The checkbox turns a schedule off and on, Run now starts it at once, Edit changes it and Delete removes it; a fill that is running for it stops and deletes its files.

Every scheduled run, newest first: when it started, which folder, and how it ended. A run that was skipped or failed says why, and a run the system started late says so. A run needs no one at the screen, and a running one shows a notification.
Removes all recorded scheduled runs. Your saved schedules stay as they are.
Shown on Android 13 and later when notification permission is off. Tap it to allow notifications for running scheduled fills, or open notification settings if it was declined earlier.
Pauses all saved schedules at once without turning each one off, or resumes them again.
Asks for confirmation, then clears the list of past runs while keeping your saved schedules.
